{{Quote|When I lent you that weapon, you lent me your own, as is our tradition.|Eeth Koth, undergoing the Concordance of Fealty with Mace Windu|<ref name="SW13" />}}
A '''blue-bladed lightsaber''' was carried by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] during his membership of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TPMVDx">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> An unexceptionally constructed [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]], the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] had a metallic [[Color/Legends|gray]] ribbed [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]] with a conical segment of radiator casing on its pommel, and a red length adjuster for its blue blade.<ref name="FF" />

==History==
[[File:EarlyMace.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Windu with blue-bladed lightsaber ignited.]]
Windu constructed the blue-bladed lightsaber prior to the creation of his other [[Electrum/Legends|electrum]]-finished, [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|purple-bladed one]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] preceding the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="FF" /> and wielded the blue weapon during the [[Yinchorri Uprising]]<ref name="JC3">[[Jedi Council: Acts of War 3|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'' 3]]</ref> of [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. In the [[32 BBY/Legends|following year]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Jedi Master alternated between the blue- and purple-bladed weapons.<ref name="TPMVDx" /> 

By the end of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Naboo Invasion]], Windu carried fellow Jedi Councilor [[Eeth Koth's lightsaber/Legends|Eeth Koth's lightsaber]],<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> for which he had exchanged his blue saber in the [[Concordance of Fealty]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] ceremony demonstrating mutual trust. [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] returned the lightsaber to Windu shortly before the latter embarked on a [[Lannik–Red Iaro peace negotiations|diplomatic mission]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to negotiate peace between the [[Red Iaro/Legends|Red Iaro]] terrorists and the [[R'cardo Sooflie IX|prince]] of the [[Lannik (species)/Legends|Lannik people]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="SW13" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==

In [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], Mace Windu carries a briefly-glimpsed lightsaber hilt, whose appearance is used for the action figure created during the film's production,<ref>[[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|''Star Wars: The Power of the Force'' (1995)]]</ref> but differs from the radiator-casing version shown in reference materials released afterwards.<ref>[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref><ref name="TPMVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> This discrepancy is explained in the [[1999]] [[Dark Horse Comics]] series [[Star Wars: Emissaries to Malastare|''Emissaries to Malastare'']], as being a result of Windu having exchanged his lightsaber with Eeth Koth's during the time of the film's events, in the Concordance of Fealty ritual.<ref name="SW13" />

Although the [[2000]] [[Dark Horse Comics]] series [[Star Wars: Jedi Council: Acts of War|''Jedi Council: Acts of War'']] shows Mace Windu to wield a blue-bladed lightsaber during the Yinchorri Uprising,<ref name="JC3" /> an image of the event in [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]'s [[2005]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' depicts Windu's lightsaber with a purple blade.<ref name="NEC" /> Similarly, the blue-bladed saber's appearances in the [[Star Wars (1998) 22|22nd]]<ref name="SW22">[[Star Wars (1998) 22|''Star Wars'' (1998) 22]]</ref> and [[Star Wars (1998) 23|23rd]] issues of the [[Star Wars: Republic|''Star Wars'']] comic book series<ref name="SW23">[[Star Wars (1998) 23|''Star Wars'' (1998) 23]]</ref> were recolored purple when reprinted in [[2010]]'s ''[[Star Wars Omnibus: Quinlan Vos: Jedi in Darkness]]''.<ref name="Omnivos">''[[Star Wars Omnibus: Quinlan Vos: Jedi in Darkness]]''</ref> In the same ''Omnibus'', the reprinted [[Star Wars (1998) 41|41st]] issue also recolors the saber to purple, but only in its retelling of events post-Yinchorri Crisis, while maintaining the blue blade as originally portrayed during said event.<ref name="Omnivos" />

The lightsaber carried by Mace Windu in the [[Star Wars Tales 13|''Star Wars Tales'' 13]] comic story "[[Children of the Force (comic story)|Children of the Force]]" has a purple blade, but a hilt resembling that of Windu's blue-bladed weapon.<ref name="CotF">{{Tales|13|Children of the Force (comic story)}}</ref>
